title: Permit Size and the Ridgeline Installation Services Permit Handling Fee
content:
The permit handling fee on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is worked out from a permit-size amount that follows the size of the municipal permit fee. The permit-size amount is rounded only where the rule below says so; the permit handling fee worked out from it is rounded to the cent only at the end, no amount on the way to it being rounded.

**Permit-size rule.** The permit fee at cost is every permit fee line charged on the contract; when it is at or above the major-permit floor of 500.00, the permit-size amount is the program's permit handling fee plus the major-permit percentage of 5 percent of the permit fee at cost, that percentage amount rounded to the cent; when it is above 0 and below the minor-permit ceiling of 100.00, the permit-size amount is the program's permit handling fee multiplied by the minor-permit share of 0.5 and rounded to the cent; otherwise the permit-size amount is the program's permit handling fee.

| Permit fee at cost (total of the permit fee lines) | Permit-size amount |
|---|---|
| 500.00 or more | the program's fee plus 5 percent of the permit fee at cost |
| 100.00 up to, but not including, 500.00 | the program's fee |
| above 0 and below 100.00 | the program's fee multiplied by 0.5, rounded to the cent |
| 0.00 (no permit fee line) | the program's fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program permit handling fee 75.00)

| Permit fee at cost | Permit-size amount |
|---|---|
| 640.00 | 75.00 plus 32.00, which is 107.00 |
| 523.40 | 75.00 plus 26.17, which is 101.17 |
| 500.00 | 75.00 plus 25.00, which is 100.00 |
| 499.99 | 75.00 |
| 100.00 | 75.00 |
| 99.99 | 37.50 |
